subject: [PATCH v5 08/12] mm/page_alloc: retry allocations that raced with a zonelist rebuild

2026-11-01.patch_summary: This patch addresses a problem where GFP_KERNEL allocations can land in the wrong zone due to concurrent zonelist rebuilds. It introduces a new function, `check_retry_zonelist`, which checks if the zonelist has changed since the allocation was made and retries the allocation if necessary. This is done by freeing the allocated page and retrying the allocation. The patch also adds a new function, `zonelist_iter_sample`, which samples the zonelist sequence number without waiting for the writer to finish. This allows for faster allocation paths to detect concurrent rebuilds and retry allocations accordingly.
